home.headline: Wear the whole scene.
home.sub: All-over print anime tees from Rogers Inc — neon rain, empty armour, twin blades, red sun. Printed edge to edge. Designed in Australia.
home.alt: Art on every inch. Free shipping in Australia.

about: Rogers Inc Designs is the brand. Elemental Wood is our Etsy shop name for the same art — original anime-style art made in Australia. We start with wallpapers and all-over print tees: dark streets, neon rain, oni masks, quiet nights, and stars. No franchise art. Every tee is printed, cut and sewn to order, so the print can sit a little differently at the seams from shirt to shirt. That’s the point of a full-bleed piece.

shop.intro: Eight designs. Two fabrics. One full-bleed print.
shop.fabrics: Pick polyester for bright colour that holds up, or soft cotton for a matte everyday feel. Free shipping within Australia.
shop.collection: Tradition × tech. Magenta and cyan on black. Streetwear gallery energy.

shipping: Free shipping within Australia on all tees. Orders are made to order with our print partner, then posted to you. Allow production time before the parcel is on the road — we’ll email when it ships. International shipping isn’t offered yet.
delivery: Because every tee is made to order, please allow about 5–12 business days for printing and Australian delivery once the order is confirmed. Times can vary with the print partner and Australia Post.
returns: These tees are made to order, so we can’t take returns for change of mind or wrong size once production has started. If your order arrives damaged or with a clear print fault, email us within 7 days of delivery with photos and your order number and we’ll sort a remake or refund under Australian Consumer Law. Nothing in this policy limits your rights under the Australian Consumer Law.
returns_contact_gap: The contact email for print faults is not on this site yet.

checkout.stripe: Pay securely by card. You’ll get an order confirmation by email.
checkout.payid: Checkout will show PayID details. Your order is held until payment clears, then we send it to print.
checkout.demo_lead: This shop is in demo mode. You can walk through checkout, but no payment will be taken and no shirt will be printed or shipped.
checkout.demo_emphasis: no payment will be taken and no shirt will be printed or shipped.
checkout.demo_tail: Place a real order once payments are switched on, or buy the matching designs on our Etsy shop meanwhile.
checkout.off: Payments are not switched on. No payment will be taken and no shirt will be printed.

fulfillment_note: Printful fulfilment is started from the order record after payment — not instant auto-push until that pipeline is live.
